2609.21636.title: Steering LLMs Responses Towards Moral Foundations on the Norwegian MFQ-30
2609.21636.paper_summary: Recent work applies human psychometric questionnaires to large language models to elicit moral and value profiles, but it is not clear whether these instruments measure anything stable in models or whether the resulting profiles can be moved toward a target human population. We administer the Norwegian Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30) to six open-weight LLMs and compare their foundation profiles to a sample of N = 1,282 Norwegian respondents. We test two steering interventions, prompt-level persona steering and activation-level ActAdd. Half the models engage with the questionnaire under our attention check. The other half default to flat or central-tendency outputs that look near-human on average without tracking item content. A neutral Nordic-respondent persona, written without any distributional information from the human sample, brings the engaging models 44-77% closer to the Norwegian mean in Mahalanobis $d^2$. One-pair ActAdd at a fixed mid-layer flattens the foundation profile rather than steering individual foundations. For at least one model the same persona that shifts the profile also induces engagement that was absent at baseline, a concrete instance of the cognitive phantoms that Peereboom et al. (2025) warn about.
2609.21636.paper_summary_zh: 最近的研究將人類心理測量問卷應用於大型語言模型，以引出道德和價值概況，但尚不清楚這些工具是否測量模型中的任何穩定性，或所產生的概況是否可以朝向目標人類群體移動。我們對六個開放權重的LLM進行了挪威道德基礎問卷（MFQ-30）的測試，並將它們的基礎概況與1,282名挪威受訪者的樣本進行比較。我們測試了兩種引導干預，提示級別的人格引導和激活級別的ActAdd。半數模型在我們的注意檢查下參與了問卷調查。另一半則默認為平坦或中心趨勢的輸出，平均看起來接近人類，但未跟蹤項目內容。一個中立的北歐受訪者人格，未使用任何來自人類樣本的分佈信息，使得參與的模型在Mahalanobis $d^2$上更接近挪威的平均值44-77%。在固定中層進行的一對ActAdd使基礎概況變得平坦，而不是引導個別基礎。對於至少一個模型，改變概況的人格也引發了在基線時缺失的參與，這是Peereboom等人（2025）所警告的認知幻影的一個具體實例。
2609.21636.author: Hans Andersen et.al.
